description: Enumerates universal DCP red lanes (hard blocks and project gates). Every lane carries a provenance tag. DCP-RED-MERGE-SEAM-0001 is a named absolute red line. schema_version .v0 = unstable, not authority.

lanes.description: Ordered list of red-lane definitions. Each lane carries provenance and gate classification.

description.description: Human-readable description of the red lane.

gate.description: hard_block = universal absolute block; project_gate = context-scoped gate.

paths_forbidden.description: Filesystem paths (relative to repo root) forbidden by this lane. Present only for path-specific lanes.

provenance_tag.description: Per-lane provenance tag. REPO_VALIDATED_BY_AUDIT = verified by auditor against origin/main.

source_ref.description: REV1 §5 + ground-truth verification of origin/main paths.

tag.description: REPO_VALIDATED: core lane taxonomy is grounded in repo-verified paths.

schema_version.description: .v0 suffix per K-27; unstable version marker, not an authority claim.

taxonomy_id.description: Unique identifier for this taxonomy instance.

state.description: REPO_CROSS_CHECKED: core lanes verified against origin/main.

title: DCP Red Lane Taxonomy
